title: Held-out state-separation evaluation of frozen Z8+G8 coordinate
purpose: Evaluate the already frozen discovery-selected coordinate on H01-H04 without changing the coordinate, induced norm, theta floor, histories, or Reference policy.

frozen_coordinate.induced_norm: maximum over bands of abs(delta_mean), except 140-160 cm uses max(abs(delta_theta15),abs(delta_theta16))

library_authority.reference_policy: ROM1AR2 frozen strict-first research Reference policy

evaluation_population.pair_included_if: at least one member is H01-H04

deterministic_failure_manifest.if_collisions_exist: persist first 8 ordered by candidate induced distance ascending, full theta distance descending, then history/step lexical order
deterministic_failure_manifest.purpose: freeze diagnostic pairs for a later separately preregistered held-out probe workunit; no probe is executed in B4

next_rule.if_zero_collisions: freeze within-material B01 state-sufficiency evidence and proceed to the separately declared B14 material-transfer challenge
next_rule.if_any_collision: reject Z8+G8 on held-out state separation; do not enrich from H01-H04; a new candidate would require a new uncontaminated evaluation design
